basic_profile.bio: CuriousExplorer22 is a 22-year-old male based in Long Island, New York. Currently single and exploring his sexuality, he is open to new experiences and connections. By day, he is an aspiring graphic designer working freelance while pursuing a degree in digital media. Known for his adventurous spirit, he enjoys late-night scrolling through Reddit, usually between 10 PM and 2 AM. His interests include art, music, and social gatherings, but he dislikes judgmental attitudes and close-mindedness.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: CuriousExplorer22 has a burgeoning understanding of digital media and graphic design, primarily self-taught through online courses and tutorials. He's also gaining hands-on experience through freelance projects and collaborations with local artists.
